findings.reason: New 2.1.25 entry is placed at the top of HOST_API_UNVERSIONED_CHANGES, while the rest of the list is appended roughly in release order (0.2.4 … 2.1.21 last). Appending after the 2.1.21 entry would keep the record chronological.

The [entity:get-api-entities-type-slug-versions] test proves the 'declared 200 response' by regex-matching the handler's exact source line and the shared interface text; brittle to cosmetic changes. A type-level assertion would hold the contract without depending on formatting.

ENTITY_VERSIONS_ROUTE is an exported runtime constant only the test reads; nothing ties its path/dto strings to the real route, so they can drift silently. Acceptable as a documented stand-in (no route-schema layer in the repo, see decisions.md).
